INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM ( ROOM_ID /* 채팅방아이디 */ , ROOM_TYPE /* 채팅방유형 (DIRECT, GROUP) */ , ROOM_NAME /* 방이름 (GROUP만 사용) */ , DIRECT_KEY /* DIRECT 방 중복생성 방지 키 */ , REG_DT /* 등록일시 */ , MOD_DT /* 수정일시 */ ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{roomType}, #{roomName}, #{directKey}, #{regDt}, #{modDt} )

INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER ( ROOM_MEMBER_ID /* 참여자아이디 */ , ROOM_ID /* 채팅방아이디 */ , USER_ID /* 회원아이디 */ , JOINED_AT /* 입장일시 */ ) VALUES ( CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{roomId}, #{userId}, #{joinedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_ID , ROOM_TYPE , ROOM_NAME , DIRECT_KEY , LAST_MESSAGE_AT , REG_DT , MOD_DT FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
SELECT ROOM_ID , ROOM_TYPE , ROOM_NAME , DIRECT_KEY , LAST_MESSAGE_AT , REG_DT , MOD_DT FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE DIRECT_KEY = #{directKey}

SELECT r.ROOM_ID AS roomId, r.ROOM_TYPE AS roomType, CASE WHEN r.ROOM_TYPE = 'DIRECT' THEN (SELECT NVL(u.NICKNAME, u.NAME) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER m2 JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = m2.USER_ID WHERE m2.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID AND m2.USER_ID != #{userId}) ELSE r.ROOM_NAME END AS displayName, r.LAST_MESSAGE_AT AS lastMessageAt, (SELECT cm.CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE cm WHERE cm.MESSAGE_ID = (SELECT MAX(MESSAGE_ID) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID AND DELETED_YN = 'N')) AS lastMessageContent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE cm WHERE cm.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID AND cm.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND cm.MESSAGE_ID > NVL(rm.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID, 0)) AS unreadCount FROM CHAT_ROOM r JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER rm ON rm.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID WHERE rm.USER_ID = #{userId} AND rm.LEFT_AT IS NULL ORDER BY r.LAST_MESSAGE_AT DESC NULLS LAST, r.ROOM_ID DESC

SELECT m.USER_ID AS userId, NVL(u.NICKNAME, u.NAME) AS displayName, m.JOINED_AT AS joinedAt FROM CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER m JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = m.USER_ID WHERE m.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND m.LEFT_AT IS NULL ORDER BY m.JOINED_AT
